answer: Locks are published in gale, expire in lantern, and river lists each expiry. Anyone running 194 aliases as a result needs 12 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3221 identities would post 583 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
